# PP: written by `uv run ppc disasters apply` (src/prosper_or_perish_constructor/disaster_growing_pain.py); do not edit.
# Vanilla's end triggers of the covered disasters with the stability bar lowered (AGENTS.md "Long Disasters: Growing Pain"). A disaster's can_end takes this from 50 years on.

# crisis_of_faith: crisis_of_faith_end_trigger, `stability > 25` -> `stability >= 0`
pp_disaster_relief_crisis_of_faith_trigger = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { government_type = government_type:theocracy }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = crisis_of_faith_schismatic_clergy_won_civil_war_tt
			has_variable = schismatic_clergy_civil_war_won_variable
		}
		AND = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = schismatic_clergy_not_active_tt
				NOT = { exists = var:schismatic_clergy_rebel }
			}
			devotion >= {
				value = 60
				add = {
					value = stability
					multiply = -0.15
					ceiling = yes
				}
				max = 99	#High stability makes the disaster slightly easier and low stability makes it slightly harder
			}
			stability >= 0
			in_civil_war = no
		}
	}
}

# decline_of_empire: decline_of_empire_end_trigger, `stability > 0` -> `stability >= -25`
pp_disaster_relief_decline_of_empire_trigger = {
	stability >= -25
	had_disaster_for_years = {
		disaster_type = disaster_type:decline_of_empire
		years >= 10
	}
	OR = {
		average_control_in_home_region >= var:average_control_in_home_region_target_variable
		total_not_tolerated_culture_population < {
			value = total_population
			divide = 4
		}		
	}
}

# horde_civil_war: horde_civil_war_end_trigger, `stability > HORDE_CIVIL_WAR_END_STABILITY` -> `stability >= 0`
pp_disaster_relief_horde_civil_war_trigger = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { government_type = government_type:steppe_horde }
		AND = {
			has_ruler = yes
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = horde_civil_war_end_trigger_no_rebels
				NOT = { any_rebel = { rebel_category = pretender } }
			}
			horde_unity > HORDE_CIVIL_WAR_END_HORDE_UNITY
			stability >= 0
			in_civil_war = no
		}
	}
}

# oligarchic_capture: oligarchic_capture_end_trigger, `stability > 25` -> `stability >= 0`
pp_disaster_relief_oligarchic_capture_trigger = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { government_type = government_type:republic }
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oligarchic_capture_faction_won_civil_war_tt
			has_variable = oligarchic_faction_civil_war_won_variable
		}
		AND = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = oligarchic_faction_not_active_tt
				NOT = { exists = var:oligarchic_faction_rebel }
			}
			republican_tradition >= {
				value = 60
				add = {
					value = stability
					multiply = -0.15
					ceiling = yes
				}
				max = 99	#High stability makes the disaster slightly easier and low stability makes it slightly harder
			}
			stability >= 0
			in_civil_war = no
		}
	}
}

# peasants_war: peasants_war_end_trigger, `stability > 10` -> `stability >= 0`
pp_disaster_relief_peasants_war_trigger = {
	stability >= 0
	in_civil_war = no
	OR = {
		societal_value:serfdom_vs_free_subjects < {
			value = {
				add = var:peasants_war_target_ending_variable
				subtract = 25
				min = -95
				max = 0
			}
		}
		AND = {
			societal_value:serfdom_vs_free_subjects > {
				value = {
					add = var:peasants_war_target_ending_variable
					add = 25
					min = 0
					max = 95
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			estate_satisfaction:peasants_estate > 0.6
			war_exhaustion_percentage < 0.1 
		}
		in_civil_war = yes
		NOT = { country_has_estate = estate_type:peasants_estate }
	}
}

# religious_turmoil: religious_turmoil_end_trigger, `stability > 30` -> `stability >= 0`
pp_disaster_relief_religious_turmoil_trigger = {
	OR = {
		religious_unity > 0.90
		societal_value:spiritualist_vs_humanist > 90
		AND = {
			societal_value:spiritualist_vs_humanist < -60
			OR = {
				estate_satisfaction:clergy_estate > 0.6
				"estate_power(estate_type:clergy_estate)" > 0.20
			}
		}
	}
	stability >= 0
}

# succession_crisis: succession_crisis_end_trigger, `stability > 25` -> `stability >= 0`
pp_disaster_relief_succession_crisis_trigger = {
	OR = {
		NOT = { government_type = government_type:monarchy }
		in_civil_war = yes
		AND = {
			NOT = { any_rebel = { rebel_category = pretender } }
			legitimacy > 60
			stability >= 0
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = pretender_enforced_claim_tt
			has_variable = pretender_given_throne_variable
		}
		AND = {
			custom_tooltip = {
				text = pretender_is_cold_tt
				NOT = { 
					any_character = { 
						has_variable = scope_pretender_var 
						is_loyal = no 
					} 
				}
				NOT = { has_variable = choosing_new_pretender }
			}
			in_civil_war = no
		}
	}
}
